features.name: Source zero-argument Unit composable callback types
features.scope: Genuine explicit imports/aliases and qualified Composable type uses preserve logical metadata and the physical Function2 ABI. Ordinary function parameters, returns and locals support typed identity/forwarding, capture and actual Composer-aware invocation. Four Kotlin provider/frontend combinations, fixed Java callers, generic callable signatures and a61-case existing Compose regression execute successfully.
restrictions: Only direct nonnullable nonreceiver nonsuspend zero-argument Unit callbacks are supported. Canonical qualified annotation names and explicit imports/aliases are recognized; wildcard-only type annotation imports and other type annotations remain unsupported. Source composable declarations, nested literal creation, conditional invocation, composite callback shapes and source class stability exports remain explicit unsupported boundaries.
